stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure9.gif##

figureAlts.figure9.gif: (e) Fill in the code below to simulate 10000 trials of our permutation test. A fill-in-the-blank code block with four blanks. The first line initializes test_stats with a blank. The second line sets repetitions to a blank. The third line is a for loop iterating over np.arange with a blank. Inside the loop, one_stat is assigned a blank. The final line appends one_stat to test_stats using np.append.
